audit.why: Vex counters Yone all game (54.4% WR, 2967 games); packet and content charts say Vex on all seven rows. Full chart said Skill everywhere — flipped.
Spikes: 3-5 W-interrupt window, 6 R punish of his E-cast, first item burst, late teamfight control. All four present and Yone-specific.

Content interactions are genuinely specific: Q3 knockup interrupted by empowered W, dashes feeding Doom, R-recast timing vs his E snap-back, passive shield tracking. tradeGood/tradeBad dash template is the true mechanic vs Yone, so it stays.
audit.corrected: Only the lint-flagged duplicate bullets rewritten.
Added Soul Unbound 22-10s, Spirit Cleave 14s base, own W 16s.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Check it before every step-up. - W Personal Space is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining, 22s at rank 1 falling to 10 — survive the burst window and punish the body he snaps back to. - Spirit Cleave shields every 14s or less: trade while it is down. - Your W (16s) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: E-mark the contact, Q through the marked line for the fear, auto, walk — every trade he answers with a dash just schedules the next fear.
edits.after: His Q3 or E dash marks him with Gloom — consume the mark with your bolt inside that window and the trade pays out double for free.

edits.before: Spending the W pulse on poke spacing and then eating the real engage unfeared — the pulse is the matchup against everything that moves fast.
edits.after: Shadow Surge's recast is the execute — fire it while he is feared and low; wait too long and Spirit Cleave shields the kill away.

edits.before: Q-poke the last-hits — the accelerating bolt chips from a deceptive range and Gloom marks tax every connect.
edits.after: Level 1 he must walk up melee to last-hit with no dash yet — your Q chips every step from 1200 range.

edits.before: W online: the shield-fear pulse means anyone who dashes onto you regrets the itinerary.
edits.after: W online: the shield-fear pulse means any early Q3 or dash onto you regrets the itinerary.

edits.before: Full kit: E-mark into Q-fear is your trade engine — every passive proc is crowd control he scheduled for you.
edits.after: Full kit: E-mark into Q-fear is your trade engine — every dash he casts is CC he scheduled for you.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — mark-and-bolt every wave contact; the fear windows zone harder than the damage.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — his Q3 and E engages keep feeding Doom; every all-in he starts favors you.

edits.before: Shadow Surge online — any skirmish in missile range is now your business; the reset execute travels.
edits.after: Shadow Surge online — R punishes his E-cast and the recast executes the body he snaps back to.

edits.before: Luden's spike: the full marked rotation chunks half bars and fears the answer. Force the gloom war.
edits.after: Luden's spike: E-Q-W plus R shreds him before Spirit Cleave's shield can catch the damage up.

edits.before: Late Vex is anti-engage incarnate: their dive feeds your fears, your R feeds on their deaths.
edits.after: Late your fear zone deletes his combo window and R picks him before he reaches your carries.

notes: Full chart was all Skill vs content/packet all Vex; flipped with rewritten whys (win[N] already Vex, side-only per chart rule). The dash-punish trade template is the genuine mechanic vs Yone, so tradeGood/tradeBad/breakdown.trading were left. Unverified from the kit: whether Vex's fear/interrupt actually stops the Soul Unbound return snap-back (spikes[0] claims it) — Riot's text calls it a forced return, not a dash; left the claim in place rather than guess. Ratings on flipped rows untouched. Content spikes[2] recommends Blackfire Torch/Liandry's while report[8] says Luden's — item-build disagreement noted, not adjudicated.
